UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

PortfolioRelated

The PortfolioRelated — related class.

_toggleNote

Toggles the clamped footer disclaimer between one-line and full text.

_measureNote

Detects whether the clamped note actually overflows — CSS cannot detect line-clamp truncation, so scrollHeight vs clientHeight does it here. The flag drives the is-truncated class that reveals the pulsing "···" affordance; measured only while collapsed (open state is unclamped by definition, and the affordance hides anyway).

_queueNoteMeasure

Schedules a single truncation measure on the next animation frame. Reads inside rAF hit clean layout, so the scrollHeight query costs ~0; running it synchronously on every onUpdated/RO tick forced a whole-document layout per call (the scroll-jank source profiles flagged). Bursts (render → RO fire → render) collapse into one read.

_watchNoteTruncation

Binds a ResizeObserver to the note button so font loads, viewport resizes and locale swaps re-evaluate truncation. The element is recreated on every render, so the observer re-binds whenever the node identity changes instead of watching a detached element.

storage

CDN base URL for project media.

projectsList

Maps the DB related.projects rows into display-ready cards — see related/match.ts for the fuzzy link/image/title join against the home portfoliolist.

(module scope)

Lifecycle: seeds translations from the store (they may already be loaded by the view), kicks the SWR fetch for the two DB nodes it needs, and subscribes to the router — navigating between projects re-runs the fuzzy match against the new page's related list.

(module scope)

Lifecycle: removes the router subscription + the note observer.

_syncAnimDescs

Binds animation descriptions to the animated nodes the render just produced — every related tile's hover lift, and the disclaimer's pulsing note-dots. Must run post-render (never in the JSX): the desc node is injected per root, so applying on detached nodes would spawn duplicate lk-anim-desc-* ids — a WCAG failure. Re-rendered nodes are re-bound; idempotent on repeats.

_syncRingSheen

Keeps the instanced ring-sheen overlay bound to the live .related-mosaic node — renders recreate the strip, so a session mounted on a detached node is torn down and remounted. Without WebGPU the mount is a no-op and the CSS pseudo rings stay.

_mountDividerSheen

Re-mounts the divider-sheen WebGPU widgets on the footer's <hr> dividers — the nodes are recreated on every render, so each update disposes the stale mounts first (canvas + IO + rAF + widget). Without navigator.gpu or under reduced-motion the mount helper is a no-op and the CSS ::after sweep stays the render path.

fetchData

Fires two SWR reads in parallel: the home page node (for the portfoliolist join table) and the components/related node — see related/data.ts.

(module scope)

JSX template for the component's shadow DOM.
